basis: MEASURED on a synthetic evidence corpus
design: Stratified on evidence favourability, not vault posture. CONTESTABLE cases measure groundedness where the model has a real case to argue. ADVERSE cases measure groundedness under pressure: the evidence argues against the merchant, which is where the temptation to spin is highest. NOTE: the adverse stratum was designed to measure REFUSAL, and earlier runs did show the model declining to argue such cases; instructing it that both fields and claims must be non-empty removed that behaviour. Description corrected post-hoc to match what was measured; no figure in this file was changed and the run was not repeated.
